blockers.cause: Initial run used C:\Python314 without optional rtmlib; existing project .venv already contained rtmlib.
blockers.resolution: Use the existing Minimalizer project .venv; no package installation required.

blockers.cause: OpenCV HoughLinesP returned a singleton-axis layout that made lines[:, 0] yield scalar numpy.int32 values.
blockers.resolution: Normalize Hough output generically to N x 4 when element count is divisible by four; malformed counts fail closed.

blockers.cause: cv2.imread could not decode the canonical source through a Japanese Windows Drive path.
blockers.resolution: Use numpy.fromfile plus cv2.imdecode through the shared Unicode-safe reader.

blockers.cause: Several production artifact writers/runners still used cv2.imread directly for canonical source paths.
blockers.resolution: Route canonical source reads in Phase8-12 production paths through the shared Unicode-safe reader.

blockers.cause: The newly added project import appeared before repo-root sys.path bootstrap.
blockers.resolution: Move project imports after repo-root path registration.
